method: One skeptic agent per vendor read the dated screenshots in this directory and the live pricing page, and refuted every fact then recorded in apps/public-site/src/content/sources.ts. sources.ts was rewritten from these verdicts; facts a screenshot does not show were dropped.

Live page confirms shared-cpu-4x · 1GB: $0.0108 per hour, $7.78 per month, but adds "Compute prices are for Ashburn (iad); other regions vary" and "Billed by the second while a Machine runs". The cited evidence file does not back this fact; confirmed by the live page only, and the recorded unit omits the Ashburn-only, billed-by-the-second caveat.

differences.recorded: { usd: 38, unit: "per month for the Basic managed Postgres cluster" }
differences.observed: Not visible in either screenshot: the Managed Postgres tab is collapsed in --full.jpg and absent from --table.png. Live page confirms Basic (shared-2x · 1GB) $38/mo, but states database storage is "Billed on provisioned capacity" at "$0.28" per GB (max 1,000 GB per cluster) and no storage is included in the plan price. differences.recorded: "$10 of compute credit, one Micro instance"
differences.observed: Page: "Paid plans include $10/mo in compute credits, enough to cover one Micro instance." and "First instance is free on paid plans". The Pro card lists what $25 actually includes and the module omits all of it: 100,000 monthly active users (then $0.00325 per MAU), 8 GB disk size per project (then $0.125 per GB), 250 GB egress (then $0.09 per GB), 250 GB cached egress (then $0.03 per GB), 100 GB file storage (then $0.0213 per GB), Email support, Daily backups stored for 7 days, 7-day log retention. differences.observed: Pro card: "$20 minimum usage", "Includes $20 of monthly usage credits", "Unlimited workspace seats included". The phrase "per workspace" appears nowhere on the page (raw HTML searched); the page frames $20 as a monthly minimum that is fully usable as usage credit, not a per-workspace subscription fee.

Hobby card: "$5 minimum usage", "Includes $5 of monthly usage credits", "Single developer workspace". FAQ: "Your Hobby plan subscription includes $5 of usage per month ... If your total usage exceeds $5 in any given billing period, you will be charged total usage"; "Included usage is reset at the end of every billing cycle and does not accumulate". Number matches; the unit omits the page's "minimum usage" framing.

Free card: "Start with a 30-day free trial with $5 credits, then $1 per month". The string "$1 of" is absent from the page; "$1 per month" is the page's ambiguous wording. FAQ: trial is "a one-time grant of $5 in credits ... expire in 30 days". Module omits the $5 trial and the hard caps on the card: "Up to 1 vCPU / 0.5 GB RAM per service", "0.5 GB of volume storage" (compare table after trial: 1 project, 3 services per project, 1 replica, 0 custom domains, global regions unavailable, 3-day log retention).

CPU: "$0.00000772 per vCPU / sec" (JSON-LD value 0.0000077160 per vCPU-second). No "$20 per vCPU" or per-month CPU price exists on the page; $20 is a derived figure: $20.01 for a 30-day month, $20.29 for 730 h, $20.68 for 31 days. The only "per vCPU-month" wording on the page is the sandbox line "about $50 per vCPU-month, active use only".
